Container.Name: ember
Container.Overview: Display Claude/Codex activity on an Ulanzi TC001 running AWTRIX3.
Container.Description:
Display Claude/Codex activity on an Ulanzi TC001 running AWTRIX3.
**Before you click Apply on first install:**
1. From your Unraid host shell (Terminal plugin or SSH), fetch the config (it ships with the default port `:3627` preset): `mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/ember && curl -fsSL -o /mnt/user/appdata/ember/config.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tarakanof/ember/main/config.example.json` 2. **Create the writable data dir and give it to the container's non-root user (UID 65532) — the image runs as distroless `nonroot`, so an un-chowned appdata bind fails with `unable to open database file`:** `mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/ember/data && chown -R 65532:65532 /mnt/user/appdata/ember/data` (Skip this and the server still runs, but can't persist Pomodoro stats, Weather/Reminders config, or the menu-chosen clock URL.) 3. Optionally set `awtrix.http_base_url` to your AWTRIX device URL (e.g. `http://192.168.0.14`). You can leave it as-is — with host networking Ember auto-discovers the clock on the LAN via mDNS. 4. Generate a token: `openssl rand -hex 32` — paste into the EMBER_TOKEN field above. 5. Click Apply. This container uses **host networking** (required for mDNS discovery); make sure port 3627 is free on the Unraid host.
**Verify after start (from the Unraid host shell, NOT the Console icon — the runtime image is distroless and has no shell):** `docker exec ember /ember doctor` Every check should be `[OK]`. Replace `ember` with whatever name you gave the container in the template UI.
**Upgrade:** Click "Force Update" in the Unraid Docker UI. Pulls the latest `:latest` image; in-flight requests drain on stop.
**Uninstall:** Stop + Remove the container. The appdata folder is preserved unless you delete it manually.
See https://github.com/tarakanof/ember for full documentation.

Config.Name: Data dir
Config.Description: Writable store for Pomodoro stats, Weather/Reminders config, and the menu-chosen clock URL (the SQLite db_path). Without this volume those reset on every container update. Must be writable.

Config.Name: Config dir
Config.Description: Bind mount; on first start copy config.example.json from the repo into this folder as config.json and set awtrix.http_base_url to your device (or leave it blank — on host networking Ember auto-discovers the clock via mDNS).

Config.Name: EMBER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token producers must send on /v1/* writes. Choose anything random; copy it to your producer hosts.

Config.Name: CONFIG_PATH
Config.Description: Path to config.json inside the container. Default matches the bind mount above; only change if you renamed the file.

Config.Name: EMBER_MDNS_ADVERTISE
Config.Description: Optional. Set to 0 to stop advertising this server over mDNS (_ember._tcp), used by the macOS app's server discovery. Default on. (Requires host networking to reach the LAN.)

Config.Name: EMBER_TLS_CERT_FILE
Config.Description: Optional. Path to a PEM cert inside the container to enable HTTPS. Set both this and EMBER_TLS_KEY_FILE; bind-mount your cert dir separately. See README's TLS section.

Config.Name: EMBER_TLS_KEY_FILE
Config.Description: Optional. Path to the matching PEM key inside the container.

Config.Name: EMBER_HEALTHCHECK_INSECURE
Config.Description: Optional. Set to '1' if you enabled TLS with a self-signed cert and want the in-image healthcheck to skip TLS verification.
